disclaimer: Coach owns technique and level placement. MeetReady tracks the household plan. Mobility and special requirements follow USAG 2026–27 Rules & Policies, 2021–2029 DP compulsories (L1–5), 2026–2030 DP Optional Code (L6–10), and 2022–2028 Xcel Code (extended through 7/31/28). Xcel cannot satisfy Development Program mobility. State qualifier scores are not national mobility. Missing SR −0.50 off SV. Restricted skill = no VP, −0.50 off SV.

dp_5.helper: Last compulsory. 32.00 AA toward optionals. Coach aid on vault voids.

mobility.note: 32.00 AA at a live sanctioned meet. 32.00 AA at L5 may skip L6 and enter L7 if other entry requirements are met. Mobility back and forth between L5 and L6 is allowed.

Clear hip above horizontal OR sole circle to clear support OR stalder to clear support

dp_6.label: Level 6
dp_6.helper: First optional. Vault timers to stack ≥ underside of table. 4A+2B, SV 10.0. Missing SR −0.50 off SV. Allowable C’s = B.

mobility.note: 32.00 AA at a live sanctioned meet. Live sanctioned meets only.

goals.label: I stop guessing what the routine is missing

dp_6.proofLine: L6 is 4A+2B, SV 10.0. Missing SR is −0.50 off SV. Allowable C’s count as B. Vault is a timer to a stack at least as high as the underside of the table — not a compulsory table handspring.

3.116 ¼–½ twist on (Tsukahara entry) onto table, arrive on mat stack on the feet in straight-hollow; arm position optional.
4.111 Round-off entry (Yurchenko) onto table, arrive on mat stack on the feet in straight-hollow; arm position optional.

mobility.note: Entry into Sapphire: 32.00 AA at Diamond OR 8.5 IES (live sanctioned only). IES = athletes who compete three events or less (R&P Ch.7). Chart writes 8.5 IES — no extra formula. Min age 12th birthday (petitions to RXCC and NXCC if under age). Entry from DP 8, 9, or 10 requires AA at ≥1 sanctioned meet at that DP level. No higher Xcel division. Xcel cannot satisfy Development Program mobility.
